exposure: Maternal viral load (<50 copies/ml vs ≥50 copies/ml)
Duration of rupture of membranes (<4 hours vs ≥4 hours)
cohort: 2398 singleton pregnancies in women on combination antiretroviral therapy (cART) in pregnancy
finding: No association was found between duration of rupture of membranes and mother-to-child HIV transmission in women taking cART.
